goal: Build the conflict-aware weighted assignment write: the server pre-check that names every conflict, the skip/move choice, one transaction that writes only the confirmed set, floor plus largest-remainder weights, auto-promotion, and named refusals for out-of-set or inactive callers.
outcome: The pre-check returns contact name plus current caller for every selected contact already assigned in the campaign, and nothing is written until the assigner chooses skip or move; the confirmed write is one transaction with no partial success that re-runs the pre-check and reports offending rows by name; N = confirmed set size is distributed by floor(N x weight / total weight) plus largest remainders (ties by higher weight then list order) producing whole-number counts summing exactly to N; a destination caller outside the assignable set is rejected by name; an inactive existing caller is refused and never reactivated.

requirements.statement: CONFLICTS ARE NAMED BEFORE ANY WRITE. The primary button's count is the count that will actually be written.
THE UNIQUE KEY IS (contact_id, campaign_id). Assignment is a move: update the existing row, never insert a second one.
WEIGHTS ARE WRITE-TIME ONLY. No weights column, no weights table.
ONE TRANSACTION — re-run the pre-check inside it and roll the whole batch back on any failure.
DRAFT is allowed; COMPLETED and CANCELLED is refused.
Fixtures: you may reuse e2e/fixtures/bulk-contacts.ts, but restore any renamed fixture in a finally. The generator is idempotent on exact deterministic names.
